conditional_selectivity_harm_frontier.interpretation: The one frozen zero-failure positive cell is far too sparse for conditional V3 harm noninferiority. This is arithmetic, not transport evidence.

open_world_reference_nonidentification.statement: Without an authoritative exhaustivity certificate, a candidate absent from a positive reference is compatible with both GLUE and OBSTRUCTION; absence alone cannot license obstruction or point-valued harm.

scientific_conclusion: The V4 blocker is logically prior to model quality: the audited public sources do not yet supply a lawful immutable source-disjoint panel with identified binary negative truth. Consequently no coverage, harm, noninferiority or superiority result may be computed. The wider positive contribution is an open-world non-identification theorem showing why positive-reference absence cannot be converted into obstruction without an explicit closure authority.
next_discriminator: Before any new reference access, acquire or author at least three rights-cleared source-disjoint families with content-addressed inputs and references plus either explicit negative/disjointness truth or an authoritative exhaustivity certificate over a frozen candidate universe; then freeze comparator runtimes, positive-only adapters, predictions and the candidate/ideal information manifest.
